SELECT INQ_ID, MEMBER_ID, INQ_TITLE, INQ_STATUS, CREATED_AT, IS_SECRET FROM INQ
ORDER BY INQ_ID DESC LIMIT #{startNum}, #{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE INQ SET ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}, ANSWER_CONTENT = #{answerContent}, INQ_STATUS = 'DONE', ANSWERED_AT = NOW() WHERE INQ_ID = #{inqId}
mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_ID AS imageId, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, IMAGE_ORIGIN_NAME AS imageOriginName, IMAGE_NAME AS imageName, IMAGE_SIZE AS imageSize, IMAGE_TYPE AS imageType, DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM INQ_IMAGE WHERE INQ_ID = #{inqId} ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND ROLE = 'ADMIN' AND IFNULL(STATUS, 'ACTIVE') != 'WITHDRAWN'
